Initial release of baidu-intelligent-search skill.

- Integrates Baidu Qianfan "Intelligent Search Generation" API for real-time web search and AI-powered summarization in one step.
- Accepts customizable search parameters (e.g., search scope, recency, resource types, model selection, site restriction).
- Supports simplified input JSON as well as direct full-body requests for advanced use cases.
- Returns results in a user-friendly structure, including summarized answers and source references.
- Designed to work seamlessly with other structured data APIs (e.g., jisuapi) for more comprehensive answers.
- Uses BAIDU_API_KEY for authentication; environment variable setup instructions included.
